azapi_resource.diag_settings sends logs to the Log Analytics workspace ID constructed by the management configuration module, but has no dependency on azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When that workspace is created in this apply, diagnostic settings can be submitted before their destination exists. Reference the managed workspace ID, with a fallback for an externally supplied workspace.

fix.expression: jsonencode({ properties = { logAnalyticsDestinationType = "null", logs = [{ category = "Administrative", enabled = true }, { category = "Policy", enabled = true }], workspaceId = try(azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management[local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id].id, local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id) } })

diagnostics.message: azurerm_virtual_hub_routing_intent.virtual_wan uses a constructed azurerm_firewall.virtual_wan resource ID as routing_policy.next_hop. Its existing dependencies wait only for the hub and its ancestors, not the firewall. Wait for azurerm_firewall.virtual_wan so the next-hop firewall exists before configuring routing intent; this also orders routing-intent deletion before firewall deletion.
